subject.title: fix(web-shared): bound response.text() fallback to honor maxBytes

question: Should `readResponseText` intentionally fail closed for capped response-like objects without readable streams, accepting that SDK/plugin-visible callers now receive an empty truncated result instead of fallback text?
rationale: The change makes the byte-cap contract honest, but it changes an exported helper's compatibility behavior for nonstandard response-like objects.

options.title: Accept fail-closed capped fallback
options.body: Keep the PR's current contract once real behavior proof is supplied, so capped reads never call whole-body fallbacks.

options.title: Preserve fallback compatibility
options.body: Define and test a compatibility path if maintainers want capped nonstream response-like objects to keep returning fallback text despite the allocation tradeoff.

options.title: Pause for broader SDK review
options.body: Hold the PR if the exported helper contract needs broader plugin/provider review before changing shipped behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed capped fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the PR's current contract once real behavior proof is supplied, so capped reads never call whole-body fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the bounded-read contract and authored the current fail-closed PR-head implementation.
